learning_objective: 🎯 Let us read a delightful poem about making paper boats and floating them on a rainy day.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Pitter-patter drops of rain make wonderful puddles on the ground. It is the best time to go out and play!
We take bright, colourful paper and fold it neatly. With a little magic of our hands, it turns into a tiny boat.
We gently put the boat in the flowing stream. It bobs up and down, sailing far away to new and unknown lands.

fun_activity.title: ⛵ Be a Boat Builder
fun_activity.instructions: Take an old newspaper or colourful sheet. Ask an elder to help you fold it into a paper boat. Try floating it in a bucket of water!

quick_recap: ⭐ Rainy days bring lots of joy and puddles of water.
⭐ Making paper boats is a very fun activity.
⭐ The boats float on the water and travel far away like real ships.
